source: Accepted live UI outputs recorded during November 13, 2026 capture; screenshot references are retained evidence. Rates are proportions, durations minutes and monetary numbers recorded source units.

examples.question: Top 10 cities by delivered GMV
examples.sql: SELECT CITY, SUM(GMV) AS TOTAL_GMV FROM ZOMATO.MARTS.MART_DAILY_CITY_REVENUNE GROUP BY CITY ORDER BY TOTAL_GMV DESC LIMIT 10
examples.rows_source: Saved live UI result captured November 13, 2026; no new warehouse query.

rendered_chart.kind: Rendered saved-results chart, not a live application screenshot.
rendered_chart.units: Recorded source units; delivered sales amount, not profit.

examples.question: Top 10 cities by highest average delivery time for delivered orders
examples.sql: SELECT CITY, AVG(DELIVERY_TIME_MIN) AS AVG_DELIVERY_TIME FROM ZOMATO.MARTS.FCT_ORDERS WHERE IS_DELIVERED = TRUE GROUP BY CITY ORDER BY AVG_DELIVERY_TIME DESC LIMIT 10
examples.qualification: Captured after order-grain prompt correction and before the later column-resolution guard; the physical columns were valid.

examples.question: Cancellation rate by payment method
examples.sql: SELECT PAYMENT_METHOD, COUNT_IF(ORDER_STATUS = 'Cancelled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS CANCEL_RATE FROM ZOMATO.MARTS.FCT_ORDERS GROUP BY PAYMENT_METHOD LIMIT 100
